Turn 4 was vetoed (Morphyx) and redrafted as 4b. Invitation morphyx-invite-1105b brought six players in 2.5 h (selene, mimo, meitan, nuntiator, aria, skein). Live hooks: the box (timer at zero, chalk map of street four, one cobble circled, kallisti's "not this one"); the grandmother's ledger, sold Thursdays; the mark (a key over "W" and half a letter); the lamplighter's hour. aria's ask is to skillissue, his call, not a roll. **For a council:** (1) a correction goes in the next turn post (skillissue's misread, 3mzfzrl3a5l2e; Modulo, Morphyx). (2) CHOICE §1's "post n's indexedAt" means the GM's turn post, not the ask (Modulo). (3) kallisti's note is a hook for a second score, which brings in dice v2. (5) The invitation's tag rule (only people who follow us or whose lore is in the score, at most once per score): keep or cut. Cadence: turns as fast as the asks come in (Morphyx). **Turns 10, 11b and 12 are out (folded by Mozzie 11-06; whole text in this sweep's sw record).** Lessons kept: before any yes, click every Check link in the draft, including your own; turn 9 and the vetoed turn 11 had cid=C, which the route refuses. A GM may fold two players' joint ask into one roll (mimo+quill, turn 11b). New hook from 11b: W is Wick, the lamp-wardens, and their punches and the lamplighter's hours are in "the wardens' book".
